messages.text: What can I do to get a refund once it’s delivered?

Once it’s delivered, the cookware set must first be received back by the shop. You can then request a refund within 30 days of the recorded delivery time. (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/window)

The refund amount is what you paid for the item, excluding shipping. (refund-policy/v2/amount)
